rows.evidence: Remote pinned dependency and builds exist; AST policy, file split, and executable traceability are incomplete.
New geometry types exist but are not canonical; intersections and complete B-rep invariants are absent.
Several legacy/limited evaluators exist; general Boolean and later feature slices are absent.
CADCommand is used for feature insertion; Agent-specific query path and generic capability fallback remain.
Typed shells and fail-closed boundaries exist; required algorithms and exact round trips do not.
